title: China's Foreign-Exchange Reserves Decline to $3.23 Trillion
主要内容: China’s foreign-exchange reserves declined to $3.23 trillion in January 2016, marking the smallest level since 2012. The People’s Bank of China reported a $99.5 billion decrease, below the Bloomberg survey’s median estimate of a $120 billion drop. The decline reflects the central bank’s intervention to counter the yuan’s retreat to a five-year low, which intensified depreciation pressure. This marks the first annual decline in foreign-exchange reserves since 2015.
